overview.description: The fund will aim to primarily obtain its notional exposure against the Underlying Stock through swap agreements. The fund manager has adopted a policy to have at least 80% of its investment exposure to financial instruments with economic characteristics that should have 2 times the performance of the Underlying Stock.
